script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Height of Ambition

INT. BUSINESS TOWER - DAY

MADDIE, mid-30s, a driven and determined businesswoman, enters the towering glass building, her stilettos clicking on the marble floor. She wears a tailored red suit, her hair pulled back in a sleek ponytail.

MADDIE (to herself)
Another day, another dollar.

INT. ELEVATOR - CONTINUOUS

Maddie enters the elevator, pressing the button for the executive floor. JASON, late 30s, a charming yet competitive colleague, enters the elevator, a smirk playing on his lips.

JASON
Maddie. Always pushing herself.

MADDIE
(sarcastically)
What can I say? I'm a go-getter.

JASON
(leaning in)
You know what I heard? The new project is mine.

Maddie's eyes widen in surprise.

MADDIE
What? But I've been working on it for weeks.

JASON
(laughs)
Sorry, babe. The boss likes my ideas better.

Maddie's expression turns steely.

MADDIE
Well, I'll just have to outdo you then.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Maddie sits at her desk, staring at her computer screen in frustration. She clenches her fists, then leans back in her chair, determined. She picks up her phone and dials a number.

MADDY (into phone)
Hey, it's Maddie. I need a favor. Can we meet for lunch? I've got some ideas I want to bounce off you.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Maddie meets with LUCAS, a close friend and fellow colleague, over coffee. They discuss strategies for outshining Jason and securing the new project.

LUCAS
(smiling)
You know what they say, Maddie. If at first you don't succeed, try, try again.

INT. BUSINESS TOWER - DAY

Maddie and Lucas present their ideas to the boss, a stern but fair executive. He listens intently, then nods.

BOSS
Excellent work, both of you. I'll be in touch.

Maddie and Lucas exchange triumphant glances.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

Maddie sits at her desk, late into the night, pouring over data and researching potential strategies. Her phone rings, and she answers, her expression brightening.

MADDY (into phone)
Yes, sir! I'll have it to you by morning.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Maddie meets with Jason over coffee, a smug expression on his face. She presents him with a folder, filled with data and comprehensive plans.

MADDIE
Here's what we'll do. I've taken the best of your ideas and built on them.

Jason's smirk fades, replaced with surprise and admiration.

JASON
Impressive, Maddie. I didn't see that coming.

MADDIE
(smiling)
I'm full of surprises.

INT. BUSINESS TOWER - DAY

Maddie and Lucas celebrate their success in the executive lounge, sipping champagne and basking in the glow of their achievement.

LUCAS
To us, the unsung heroes of this company.

They clink glasses, their eyes reflecting the determination and ambition that drives them.

FADE OUT.

The End
